_readme: First-person paper guns + origami hands (WEAPONS agent; code src/game/40-viewmodel.js PVM). map = engine weapon id -> paper gun id (data/paper/guns.json). Each gun root sits at guns.json art.hip at the hip; at full ADS the gun's `sight` empty is put on the camera axis at `eye` metres (exactly screen centre). hipRot = extra cant at the hip (degrees XYZ, fades to 0 at ADS). Hands: the CHARS rig (assets/paper/hands) posed with a named pose (paper_hands_poses.json), then its grip socket is put on the gun's grip_r (right) / grip_l (left) empty; rot = extra degrees XYZ in the grip's frame, off = extra metres. The hands are children of those empties, so they follow every clip (reload, pump, bolt, throw). scale = gun size (the GLBs are life size, 0.66 fits the screen like ref1/ref4); hip = root spot at the hip (camera space m); bones = per-gun overrides of the pose's bone rotations (degrees; 'hand' bends the wrist so the forearm runs down out of the screen).

plane._readme: the held plane (ref3): hold = the plane root's rotation at the hip (degrees XYZ: nose to the right-forward, a little up); keys = the keys that pick the plane slot; returnToGun = after a throw's flight ends you get your last gun back.

arc._readme: dashed white throw-preview arc while the plane is held (ref4): from the plane's nose, bending up then down onto the crosshair line at `dist` m
